services.name: Fishing Report
services.desc: Our four inshore charter is the perfect trip for anglers of all ages and skill levels. Whether you’re looking for a fun family outing or a chance to target Savannah’s inshore favorites, this trip has it all. We’ll fish the local waters using live bait and light tackle, giving you the best opportunity to hook redfish, trout, flounder, and more. With calm waters and plenty of action, this trip is ideal for kids, beginners, or anyone wanting a fun introduction to coastal fishing.
